dispositions.accepted: All required evidence valid for this assembly and recipe, no unresolved fault, unloading confirmed; counted once.
dispositions.held: Unresolved failure or missing/invalid evidence; remains identified and supported WIP.
dispositions.reworked: Approved intervention and replacement recorded; every affected requirement rechecked; history preserved.
dispositions.scrapped: Explicit disposition; material and WIP adjusted once; cannot be reset into accepted.

joint_control.policy: No generic M3 torque. Locknut rundown resistance and early torque must be distinguished from final tightening; modeled outputs must be labeled.
